'''Izumi Shrine''' (泉神社) refers to several [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] across Japan.

* [[Izumi Shrine (Hitachi)]] (Hitachi City, Ibaraki Prefecture) - A [[Shikinaisha]] small shrine. The [[Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines]] categorized it as a [[Gō-sha]]{{efn|District Shrines|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq= 近代社格制度}}.
* [[Izumi Shrine (Maibara)]] (Maibara City, Shiga Prefecture)
* [[Izumi Shrine (Usa)]] (Usa City, Oita Prefecture) - Formerly classified as a Gōsha.
